case.title: Ronin bridge (MainchainGateway), Ethereum, 23 Mar 2022
case.period: hack: baseline before the incident, then the drain
case.notes: The 173,600 ETH left as a WETH unwrap (WETH Withdrawal event, src = vault), kept as a weth_unwrap row; the 25.5M USDC was an ordinary Transfer. Discovered only on 29 Mar 2022.
case.coverage: USDC and WETH only; the 173,600 ETH left as a WETH unwrap (rows with kind=weth_unwrap). Valued at the file ETH price, $539.6M vs $624M reported at discovery.

price_note: Stablecoins and FRAX at $1; WETH at Chainlink ETH / USD 2,961.20 (answers at block 14442835). Native ETH is not included except where it passed through WETH (rows with kind weth_wrap / weth_unwrap).
